sim.intro: Plays the rest of the run {runs} times with the game's odds and compares a few ways to play. Probabilities only, the game's RNG is never read.
sim.no_data: No run data yet: no save file found and not connected to the game.
sim.finished: This run is over, nothing left to simulate.
sim.source_live: Data: live from the game, day {day}.
sim.assumed: The game's odds table isn't available (it needs live reading), so rough odds are used; take the result as a ballpark.
sim.row: {name}: makes it to the end {win} · ends on day {day} on average
sim.best: Best bet: {name} ({win} make it to the end)
sim.chart: Chance of still being in the run after each day
sim.assumptions: Assumes 3 fresh +0 swords a day, 3 missed tributes end the run, {strikes} strikes per Frenzy.
stats.empty: No runs logged yet. Finish a run while the overlay is running and numbers show up here.
stats.summary: {runs} runs played · {wins} won · furthest day {best} · average day {avg}
stats.first_miss: First missed tribute on day {day} on average ({runs} runs)
settings.check_updates: Check for a new version at start-up
